mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTICE n WHERE n.STATUS = 1

SELECT n.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, m.NAME AS adminName, n.TITLE AS title, n.PINNED_YN AS pinnedYn, n.HIT_COUNT AS hitCount, TO_CHAR(n.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.ADMIN_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 1
ORDER BY n.PINNED_YN DESC, n.NOTICE_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET HIT_COUNT = HIT_COUNT + 1 WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, m.NAME AS adminName, n.TITLE AS title, n.CONTENT AS content, n.PINNED_YN AS pinnedYn, n.HIT_COUNT AS hitCount, TO_CHAR(n.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.ADMIN_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE n.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND n.STATUS = 1

SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE AS title FROM NOTICE n WHERE n.STATUS = 1 AND n.NOTICE_ID > #{noticeId}
ORDER BY n.NOTICE_ID ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE AS title FROM NOTICE n WHERE n.STATUS = 1 AND n.NOTICE_ID < #{noticeId}
ORDER BY n.NOTICE_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT NOTICE_FILE_ID AS noticeFileId, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME AS originalFileName, FILE_PATH AS filePath FROM NOTICE_FILE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
SELECT NOTICE_FILE_ID AS noticeFileId, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME AS originalFIleName, FILE_PATH AS filePath FROM NOTICE_FILE WHERE NOTICE_FILE_ID = #{fileId}
